note: He matches on starting point and ambition: two years of consistent gym training four or five days a week produced a physique he is content with, and what he wants now is capability beyond it — 'I look good. Only that. And I want something more.' That is good-to-great stated as clearly as anyone in the batch, and he is nowhere near the deconditioned exclusion. Everything commercial fails. A forklift operator in rural Catalonia is not the business owner or physician the ICP describes, and income fails absolutely rather than marginally: he could afford none of the coaching tiers and could not fund the $200 self-serve product until the following month. Health is also not the neglected corner of an otherwise sorted life — it is the area he has invested most in, and an unresolved injury is now the obstacle. Worth pairing with the other outside-ICP calls in this batch: the criterion that would actually have been decisive here is a clinical one, screening whether a year-old unassessed elbow and shoulder injury can tolerate the programme, and the stated ICP still has no such criterion.
